validation.year_basis: Maintainer-confirmed 2011; prior-election columns refer to 2001/2006; historical 2011 collection
validation.source_serials: Consecutive from 1 within each PDF; checked before output
validation.scope: Source winner records, not all candidates, unique seats or statewide completeness
validation.overlap: Includes the same 338 primary Gaya PDF records as the pilot; do not add the two counts

year_assignment.basis: Maintainer-confirmed 2011; prior-election columns refer to 2001/2006; historical 2011 collection

panchayat_raw.description: GP label from this source or the linked companion winner PDF; runner links are identified by seat_link_basis

candidate_name.description: Decoded candidate name, preserving spelling and honorifics

relative_name.description: Printed father/husband name; relationship not distinguished

address_raw.description: Decoded address as reported, possibly including phone numbers in workbook

reservation_raw.description: Reported seat reservation; distinct from candidate category

gender_raw.description: Source gender spelling, even where it conflicts with another source

category_raw.description: Reported candidate social category, not seat reservation

phone_raw.description: Printed phone cell; malformed numbers retained as text

occupation_raw.description: Reported occupation, including malformed overflow text

previous_office_2001_raw.description: Source claim about elected office in 2001; blank is not coded no

previous_office_2006_raw.description: Source claim about elected office in 2006; blank is not coded no

education_raw.description: Reported qualification; no degree threshold imputed

block_raw.description: English block label as printed; capitalization retained

block.description: Hindi crosswalk available for Gaya only; otherwise null

source_box.description: JSON [left, top, right, bottom] in PDF points, top-origin

record_id.description: Source-record identifier; not a verified person or seat identifier

collection_year.description: Year of historical handoff folder; not independently verified election year

election_year.description: 2011, based on maintainer confirmation and prior-election headings

district_raw.description: District folder label; source file/page retained for verification

office.description: mukhiya, identified by the printed office heading

outcome.description: Outcome asserted by this source; contradictory sources remain separate

source_serial.description: Printed PDF serial; consecutive within the report

decode_issue_count.description: Cells set to null because glyph ordering could not be resolved; see issues.csv

missing_block.description: No readable block label recovered from heading; no carry-forward or address-based inference

seat_label_repeated.description: Repeated literal block/panchayat label within district; null if either label is missing

name_within_block_repeated.description: Repeated literal name within district/block; null if name or block missing

gender.description: female/male/other from explicit source labels; no name inference

reservation_category.description: Exact reviewed source-label mapping to unreserved/SC/ST/BC/EBC; ambiguous labels null

reservation_women.description: True for explicit female label; false for explicit other/male; otherwise null

duplicate_of_record_id.description: First record with identical decoded source cells and block in this PDF; null for first occurrence or any decoding failure

age.description: Reported age in years; values outside 18-120 left null

annual_income.description: Reported annual income; currency not explicit in the printed heading

sons.description: Reported number of sons; zero retained

daughters.description: Reported number of daughters; zero retained
